title: Local expected value
statement: For a constraint satisfaction instance with at least one constraint and with every declared variable appearing in some constraint scope, and a probability distribution on the label set for each variable, the local expected value is the sum of the constraints’ local expected satisfaction indicators, counted with multiplicity, divided by the total number of constraints counted with multiplicity.
hypotheses_covered: Every declared variable appears in some constraint scope
